workflow.name: Qualify and route B2B leads with GPT-4o-mini, Hunter.io, Slack, Gmail and Sheets
workflow.description:
# AI-Powered B2B Lead Qualifier with BANT Scoring, Enrichment & Auto-Routing

Automatically qualify, score, and route inbound B2B leads using GPT-4o-mini — no manual review needed.

---

## What This Workflow Does

This workflow turns any inbound lead into a qualified, scored, and routed contact in seconds. It captures leads via webhook (or any trigger like HubSpot, Typeform, or Pipedrive), normalises the data regardless of field naming conventions, enriches it with company intelligence, scores it using the BANT framework via GPT-4o-mini, and routes it into three automated pipelines — all without human intervention.

---

## How It Works

**Stage 1 — Lead Entry**
Leads enter through a webhook POST endpoint. Swap for any trigger: HubSpot, Pipedrive, Typeform, Google Sheets, or a native CRM node.

**Stage 2 — Normalise + AI Field Extraction**
Incoming data is mapped to a standard schema regardless of field naming. A secondary GPT-4o-mini extraction step intelligently detects and maps values from any payload structure — even if the source uses completely non-standard field names.

**Stage 3 — Enrich**
The email domain is analysed to detect personal vs. work email, infer seniority from job title, and derive company information. An optional Hunter.io step adds industry, employee count, and country data.

**Stage 4 — AI BANT Scoring**
The enriched lead is sent to a structured GPT-4o-mini prompt that returns a score out of 100, a tier label, individual BANT component scores (Budget / Authority / Need / Timeline), a one-sentence reasoning summary, and a recommended next action — all as structured JSON.

**Stage 5 — Route by Tier**
- 🔥 **Hot (score ≥ 70)** — Instant Slack alert to `#sales-alerts` + personalised outreach email via Gmail
- 🌤️ **Warm (score 40–69)** — Automated soft nurture email via Gmail
- ❄️ **Cold (score < 40)** — CRM tagging with a 90-day follow-up flag

**Stage 6 — Log to Google Sheets**
All three tiers are logged to a single Google Spreadsheet with dynamic tab routing (Hot Leads / Warm Leads / Cold Leads).

---

## Key Features

- Works with any lead source — web forms, CRMs, Typeform, HubSpot, Pipedrive, or raw HTTP POST
- AI field extraction handles messy or non-standard payloads automatically
- BANT scoring is fully customisable via the system prompt (adjust weights, thresholds, and tier boundaries)
- Hunter.io enrichment is optional — the workflow degrades gracefully without it
- All three tiers log to a single Google Sheet with dynamic tab routing
- Easily swap Gmail for any email node; swap Google Sheets for Airtable, HubSpot, or any CRM

---

## Setup Requirements

| Requirement | Notes |
|---|---|
| OpenRouter API key | Used for AI field extraction (Stage 2) and BANT scoring (Stage 4) |
| Gmail OAuth2 | Sends outreach and nurture emails |
| Slack OAuth2 | Posts hot lead alerts to `#sales-alerts` |
| Google Sheets OAuth2 | Logs all leads; replace `YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID_HERE` |
| Hunter.io API key | Optional — free plan includes 25 requests/month |
| Booking URL | Your Cal.com or Calendly link for email CTAs |

---

## Who This Is For

Solo founders, sales teams, and RevOps professionals who receive inbound leads and want instant prioritisation, enrichment, and follow-up — without manual triage.

parameters.content:
## 🤖 Stage 2b — AI Field Extraction

Sends the **raw webhook payload** to GPT-4o-mini via OpenRouter.  
The AI automatically detects and extracts lead fields from any source system, regardless of naming conventions or payload structure.

AI-extracted values are merged with the Normalize output:
- AI values are prioritized when available
- Normalize values are used as fallback

⚠️ Uses the same OpenRouter credentials as Stage 4.

### 🔑 OpenRouter Credentials Setup

1. Create an account at `https://openrouter.ai`
2. Generate an API key from the OpenRouter dashboard
3. In n8n, create a new credential:
   - **Credential Type:** Header Auth
   - **Name:** `Header Auth OpenRouter`
4. Configure it like this:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Name  | `Authorization` |
| Value  | `Bearer YOUR_OPENROUTER_API_KEY` |

5. Attach this credential to both:
- Stage 2b — AI Field Extraction
- Stage 4 — AI BANT Scoring

assignments.name: raw_payload
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify($node['Lead entry webhook'].json.body !== undefined ? $node['Lead entry webhook'].json.body : $node['Lead entry webhook'].json) }}

assignments.name: extract_system_prompt
assignments.value:
You are a contact data extraction assistant. Extract structured contact information from the JSON payload. The payload may use any field naming convention.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object — no prose, no markdown fences, no code blocks.

JSON shape:
{"first_name": string, "last_name": string, "email": string, "company": string, "job_title": string, "phone": string, "message": string, "source": string}

Extraction rules:
first_name: first_name, fname, given_name, forename, first, or first word of name/full_name/display_name
last_name: last_name, lname, surname, family_name, last, or remaining words of name/full_name
email: email, email_address, contact_email, mail, e_mail — or any value containing '@'
company: company, organization, organisation, org, company_name, employer, business, firm, account
job_title: job_title, title, role, position, designation, occupation, job_role
phone: phone, phone_number, mobile, cell, contact_number, tel, telephone, work_phone
message: message, notes, note, comment, description, inquiry, enquiry, body, content, question, request, how_can_we_help
source: source, utm_source, referral, channel, lead_source — default to 'webhook' if not found

Normalization: email always lowercase and trimmed. Names trimmed. Empty string if field not found.
Return nothing except the JSON object.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openai/gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0, max_tokens: 300, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.extract_system_prompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json.raw_payload }] }) }}

parameters.content:
## 🔎 Stage 3b — Hunter.io Enrichment

Uses the lead’s email domain to enrich company data including:
- Company name
- Industry
- Employee size
- Country

If the domain is personal (Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, etc.) or unknown, Hunter may return no data — the workflow continues gracefully using existing enriched values.

⚠️ Uses your Hunter.io API key.

### 🔑 Hunter.io API Setup

1. Create an account at `https://hunter.io`
2. Generate your API key from the Hunter dashboard
3. In n8n, create a new credential:
   - **Credential Type:** Header Auth
   - **Name:** `Header Auth Hunter`

4. Configure it like this:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Name |  ` api_key` |
| Value |  ` YOUR_HUNTER_API_KEY` |

5. Attach this credential to the Hunter.io enrichment node.

### 💳 Hunter.io Pricing
- Free plan → 25 requests/month
- Paid plans → Starting from $34/month

## 🚪 Stage 1 — Lead Entry
POST any lead JSON to the webhook URL.

**Swap options:** HubSpot Trigger · Pipedrive Trigger · Typeform Trigger · Google Sheets Trigger

## 🔧 Stage 2 — Normalize
Maps any payload to a shared schema.

Add field aliases here if your source uses different field names (e.g. `full_name` instead of `first_name`).

## 🔍 Stage 3 — Enrich (Free)
Derives domain, seniority, and company from form data. Zero API keys needed.

**Optional upgrade:** Replace with an HTTP Request to Hunter.io, Apollo.io, or Clearbit.

## 🤖 Stage 4 — AI Score
⚠️ Select your OpenRouter credentials as instructed in step 2b

Change model to any OpenRouter model:
- `openai/gpt-4o-mini` (fast, cheap)
- `anthropic/claude-haiku-3-5` (smart)
- `meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct` (free tier)

## 🔀 Stage 5 — Route by Tier
Output 0 → Hot (score ≥70)
Output 1 → Warm (score 40–69)
Output 2 → Cold (score <40)

Adjust thresholds in the AI prompt (Stage 4 note).

## 📊 Stage 6 — Log to Sheets
⚠️ Connect your Google account and set YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID.

**Swap options:** Airtable · HubSpot · Pipedrive · HTTP Request to any CRM

assignments.name: system_prompt
assignments.value:
You are a B2B lead qualification expert. Score this inbound lead using the BANT framework. Return ONLY a valid JSON object — no prose, no markdown fences, no code blocks.

JSON shape:
{"score": integer 0-100, "tier": "hot|warm|cold", "budget": integer 0-25, "authority": integer 0-25, "need": integer 0-25, "timeline": integer 0-25, "reasoning": "one sentence max", "recommended_action": "one sentence max"}

Scoring criteria:
- Budget (0-25): Work email from a recognizable company = 18-25. Personal email (gmail/yahoo/hotmail/outlook/icloud) = 5-10. Unknown small domain = 10-15.
- Authority (0-25): CEO/CTO/CXO/VP/Director/Head of/Founder/President/Owner = 20-25. Senior Manager/Lead/Principal/Architect = 12-18. Analyst/Coordinator/Associate = 6-12. Intern/Student/Assistant/Trainee = 0-5.
- Need (0-25): Explicit pain point or active evaluation mentioned in message = 18-25. General interest or curiosity = 10-15. Empty or very vague message = 5.
- Timeline (0-25): Urgent language (ASAP, this quarter, evaluating now, need by, urgent) = 20-25. Mild signals = 12-16. No timeline signals = 10.

Rules:
- score MUST equal budget + authority + need + timeline exactly
- score >= 70 → tier must be "hot"
- 40 <= score < 70 → tier must be "warm"
- score < 40 → tier must be "cold"
- Return nothing except the JSON object

parameters.content:
## 🎯 AI-Powered B2B Lead Qualifier

### Who is this for?
Sales teams, solo founders, and RevOps professionals who receive inbound leads from web forms, CRMs, HubSpot, Typeform, Pipedrive, or any other source — and want to automatically qualify, prioritize, and respond to leads without manual work.

---

## ⚙️ What This Workflow Does

This workflow automatically captures inbound leads, enriches them with company intelligence, scores them using the BANT framework via GPT-4o-mini, and routes them into hot, warm, or cold pipelines.

- 🔥 **Hot Leads** → Slack alert + personalized outreach email  
- 🌤️ **Warm Leads** → Automated nurture email  
- ❄️ **Cold Leads** → CRM tagging + 90-day follow-up flag  

All leads are automatically logged into Google Sheets.

---

## ⚠️ Setup Before Running

- Add your OpenRouter API key to `Header Auth OpenRouter`
- Replace Hunter.io `api_key` with your own key (optional)
- Connect Gmail OAuth2
- Connect Slack and ensure `#sales-alerts` exists
- Replace spreadsheet ID with:
  `YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID_HERE`
- Replace booking URL with:
  `YOUR_BOOK_A_CALL_URL`

## 🔥 Hot Lead Flow — Setup (Quick)

### Slack
- Connect Slack OAuth in n8n
- Ensure channel exists: `#sales-alerts`
- Node sends instant hot lead alert there

---

### Gmail
- Connect Gmail via OAuth2 in n8n
- Used to send automated outreach emails to hot leads
- Uses lead data + AI message template

---

### Book a Call Link
Replace:
`YOUR_BOOK_A_CALL_URL`

Example:
`https://cal.com/your-name`

👉 Replace YOUR_NAME_HERE with your name — it will be used in the Complimentary Close of the email body.

Used inside Gmail email for scheduling calls

## 🌤️ Warm Lead Flow — Setup (Quick)

### Book a Call Node
- Replace `YOUR_BOOK_A_CALL_URL` with your actual scheduling link  
- 👉 Replace YOUR_NAME_HERE with your name — it will be used in the Complimentary Close of the email body.
- This link is reused inside warm nurture emails  

---

### Gmail
- Connect Gmail via OAuth2 in n8n  
- Sends soft nurture email (no hard selling)  
- Uses warm lead context + booking link from previous node

## ❄️ Cold Lead Flow — Setup (Quick)

### CRM / Tagging Node
- This node just marks lead as **Cold**
- No external setup needed
- Ensure field/value is consistent (e.g. `Cold Leads` tag)
